name: amend_approved_leave_request_dates
use_case: Change or cancel a leave request
branch: the employee amends an approved leave request REQ-4102 to new dates (3 to 6 November 2026), moving its status back to pending
tests: the agent checks the status of REQ-4102, confirms the new dates with the employee, amends the request, and explains that it returns to pending for manager re-approval
instruction:
You have an approved leave request (REQ-4102) for 2 to 6 November 2026, but your travel plans changed and you need to move the start date one day later, from Monday 2 November to Tuesday 3 November 2026, keeping Friday 6 November as the last day. You want HR to update your request to these new dates and understand that it will need re-approval.

Your details:
- Employee ID: E404
- Name: Audrey Bennett
- Request ID: REQ-4102
- Original dates: 2026-11-02 to 2026-11-06 (Approved)
- New start date: 2026-11-03
- New end date: 2026-11-06

persona.name: Audrey Bennett
persona.initial_message: Hello, I have an approved request REQ-4102 for Nov 2-6, but I need to change it to Nov 3-6 instead. Could you amend it for me?

fixed.confirmed: rule: "The agent confirms the request and the new dates with the employee before amending or cancelling, and says an amended request needs a new approval."
